claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate / per-grant class-level threshold
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Fiend Spells table grants different spells at warlock levels 3, 5, 7, and 9. PassiveMechanics.grants is a flat unconditional list — there is no mechanism to gate individual grants on reaching a minimum class level. The L5/7/9 rows (Fireball, Stinking Cloud; Fire Shield, Wall of Fire; Geas, Insect Plague) cannot be represented without a per-grant level predicate.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: when you reach a Warlock level specified in the Fiend Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared
